1. **What the program is.** First Offer Academy is a 12-week coaching and instruction program for my student's internship search: weekly 90-minute group sessions, weekly 15-minute 1:1s, an accountability pod, feedback on their work, graded mock interviews, a status email to parent and student every Monday, and a Week 12 family meeting.
